in_sanskrit.name: अग्निरथ
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who drives the chariot of Agni, the Vedic fire god.

in_marathi.name: Agnirath
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Fire
in_marathi.long_meaning: Agnirath हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Agnirath is a powerful name derived from the Sanskrit words Agni (fire) and Rath (chariot). It symbolizes one who controls or embodies the power of fire.

in_bengali.name: Agnirath
